caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, bulbous mug or tankard with a pronounced footed base, rendered in shades of gray using pencil or graphite on off-white or yellowed paper. The body of the mug curves outward and then slightly narrows as it rises toward a wide, open mouth. Attached to the right side of the mug is an ornate, elaborately curved handle featuring decorative scrollwork at both top and bottom ends. At the bottom right corner of the drawing, within the same rectangular border as the mug, there is a small, simplified line sketch showing a side profile of the same mug and its handle. The drawing is tightly composed, with the main object occupying the central area, and the lines are precise and detailed, especially in the depiction of shading and curvature.
title: Silver Mug
